libde265 1.0.18
https://github.com/strukturag/libde265/tree/v1.0.18
Copyright (c) struktur AG and the libde265 contributors.
LGPL-3.0-or-later; see COPYING.libde265.

Compiled with Emscripten 3.1.61. No upstream source modifications.
Rebuild instructions and exact source archive hashes: README.md and
scripts/build-heif-decoder.mjs in the Filens source repository.
The JS glue and WebAssembly binary are a matched pair; replace both together.

This replaces libheif-js 1.23.5's bundled libde265 1.0.15, which corrupts the
Cr plane in some 10-bit 4:4:4 HEVC still images. Original alpha is preserved.
